messages:
Ana: quick one — for the console rollout: do we fan out full actor resolution to every routing-policy card, or just show a lightweight "actor hint" and link to the audit panel? worried about quota and perf.
Tyler: +1 for hint + link. full resolution on every card will blow our actor-lookup QPS during spikes. keep route view cheap. :eyes:
Kris: agree. we should surface who changed it (name + role) but not fetch full identity blobs. hint can be {actor_id, display_name, actor_role}. clicking the hint loads full proof via presigned export.
Leo: telemetry note — if we go hint-first we need two metrics: hint-fetch latency and detail-fetch success rate. instrument as `audit.actor_hint.latency_ms` and `audit.actor_detail.fetch_success` so SRE can set alerts.
Ana: good call. how do we gate this for tenants with strict export quotas / enterprise private? we should avoid leaking details to front-end until export entitlement is checked.
Tyler: entitlement check inline before showing detail view. policy: if tenant export quota exhausted, show masked hint with CTA to request export. mask example: "actor: [REDACTED — request export]"
Kris: small API debate — do we extend current /audit/events API with a `hint=true` param or add a dedicated /audit/hints endpoint? I prefer param to avoid an extra endpoint. keeps routing logic centralized.
Leo: param is nicer but might encourage misuse. separate endpoint makes it explicit and easier to throttle independently. also makes per-endpoint quotas simpler for infra.
Ana: leaning to a separate endpoint for throttling simplicity. can we do a thin proxy so client only calls /audit/events? internal rewrites to /audit/hints when hint mode. keeps UX unchanged.
Tyler: proxy approach works. infra: need to add quota buckets: `audit_hints` and `audit_detail_exports`. Hints bucket will have higher RPS, smaller cost. Details bucket will decrement tenant export quota.
Kris: quick snippet for the hint shape I propose:
```json
{"actor_id": "A:1234","display_name":"Jesse Park","actor_role":"admin","evidence_link":"/console/audit/exports/eps-9876"}
```
Leo: also add telemetry tag `route_id` so we can attribute which route cards generate most actor-lookups. helpful for batching improvements.
Ana: ok next steps: Tyler to prototype proxy + quota buckets, Kris to update API contract (hint shape), Leo to add telemetry fields, I'll coordinate canary in console. aim for canary next week. :thumbsup:
Audit-bot: Recorded task: audit-hint-proxy created (ticket #ENG-8421).
